description: This file defines the EmailConfig class, which models email configuration parameters such as host, port, protocol, authentication, and TLS settings. It provides getters and setters for its fields and converts its state to a JSON string representation.

classes.name: EmailConfig
classes.description: Class representing email configuration settings with JSON serialization capability.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the EmailConfig object to a JSON string, including key properties.

methods.name: isSmtpAuth
methods.description: Returns whether SMTP authentication is enabled.

methods.name: setEmailTemplatesPath
methods.description: Sets the path to email templates.

methods.name: getEmailTemplatesPath
methods.description: Gets the path to email templates.
